title: Microsoft 365 Sending Limits: A New Tenant Gets 10% for 30 Days
meta_description: Read on 6 October 2026: each Microsoft 365 mailbox may send to 10,000 recipients a day, but a new tenant gets 10% of its outside cap for 30 days.
secondary_keywords: microsoft 365 email sending limits per day
outlook cold email limit per day
